title: Diverter valve split
cause: The diaphragm in diverter valve 06F 145 710 G splits under boost
fix: Fit the piston-type valve 06H 145 710 D, listed for the Leon Mk2 Cupra

source.label: awesomegti, Genuine VAG / Pierburg piston diverter valve 06H 145 710D

title: PCV valve failure
symptoms: Whistle or honk under the bonnet at idle, rough running, power loss
cause: The diaphragm or check valve in the PCV valve fails and boost leaks past it
fix: Replace with the current revision, 06F 129 101 P or R

source.label: Dap, 2.0T FSI PCV valve failure (Paul Barrett), 11 Oct 2017

title: Carbon on the intake valves
symptoms: Misfires from cold, worse fuel economy
cause: Direct injection: fuel does not wash the intake valves
fix: Clean the valves by hand or with walnut media, intake manifold off

source.label: Dap, Carbon build up and cold start misfires on 2.0T FSI (Paul Barrett), 11 Oct 2017

title: Overboost or boost surging (N75, wastegate, hoses)
cause: N75 boost control valve sticking or the wrong variant; also the wastegate, the MAP sensor or a hose
fix: Test the N75, the wastegate rod and the hoses before replacing parts

source.label: TorqueCars, Causes of the 2.0TFSI P0234 error (Waynne Smith)
